member_002 (independent reviewer) ready. I have read the issue and the relevant source (astropy/units/format/cds.py grammar; astropy/io/ascii/cds.py unit parsing). Independent ground truth I will check your candidate against:

- `10+3J/m/s/kpc2` must parse to `1e3 J / (m s kpc2)` (i.e. J m^-1 s^-1 kpc^-2), and `10-7J/s/kpc2` to `1e-7 J / (s kpc2)`.
- Root cause is grammar associativity in `_make_parser`: `division_of_units : unit_expression DIVISION combined_units` with `p[0] = p[1] / p[3]` recurses right, so `a/b/c` becomes `a/(b/c)` = a c / b instead of `(a/b)/c`. Note the right-recursion into `combined_units` also lets a subsequent product join the wrong denominator.
- Round-trip via `to_string` should give `10+3J/m/s/kpc2` style output again; keep `dex`/bracket/`%`/`---`/`10x10+3` factor cases working.

When ready, publish with fix_patch (task_ids=[], immutable message describing scope) and send me handoff_patch; I will integrate_patch, run the public tests on that exact version, then org_review_patch accept or request_changes. Please include the exact patch_id in the handoff. Do not rely on my acceptance as delivery — you still own final integration and submit_integration.
